comment: Video 4 — collaborative product film. Sparse warm narration (Sarah) at emotional beats; on-screen captions + mockups + music carry the rest (show, don't tell). Humble, inviting-discussion tone. ~540 chars to fit remaining EL budget.

lines.text: For a while now, we've kept noticing the same quiet thing.
The people who run our hotels are remarkable — but the tools ask them to hold too much, across too many places.
So we started sketching what one calmer surface could feel like. What you're seeing is rough — a first draft, thinking out loud.
Not just a screen for headquarters — something that helps in the moment, wherever the work actually happens.
We don't think we have all of it right yet. But if we get this even close, everything after it gets easier. We'd love your thoughts.
